title: PLUR1BUS harness config.json (schemaVersion 1)
description: Configuration for the PLUR1BUS harness process, its supervisor, and optional integrations.

$schema.description: URI identifying the JSON Schema used to validate this configuration.

schemaVersion.description: Configuration format version; this schema supports version 1.

core.description: Settings for the core process, including logging, memory operation budgets, and shutdown.

logLevel.description: Minimum severity written to the core log.

recall.description: Time and response-size limits for memory recall.

softBudgetMs.description: Soft target duration for a recall, in milliseconds.

hardBudgetMs.description: Maximum duration allowed for a recall before it is aborted, in milliseconds.

capChars.description: Maximum number of characters returned by a recall.

capture.description: Limits for waiting on memory capture after a turn.

waitMs.description: Maximum time to wait for a memory capture, in milliseconds.

shutdownBudgetMs.description: Maximum time the core spends on graceful shutdown, in milliseconds.

supervisor.description: Timing settings used by the process supervisor.

graceMs.description: Grace period given to a child process to exit during shutdown, in milliseconds.

healthIntervalMs.description: Interval between child-process health checks, in milliseconds.

metrics.description: D3: the read-only Prometheus text endpoint `GET /metrics` on a loopback address, protected by a bearer token kept in `state/metrics.token`.

enabled.description: Whether to expose the read-only Prometheus metrics endpoint.

port.description: Loopback port used by the metrics endpoint.

logs.description: Retention limits for rotating harness log files.

maxBytes.description: Maximum size of each log file before rotation, in bytes.

keep.description: Number of rotated log files to retain.

agents.description: Per-agent settings keyed by a lowercase agent identifier.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the agent was created, in date-time format.

displayName.description: Optional human-readable name for the agent.

skills.description: Per-agent skill selection (X1-R11): `blocked` names skills this agent does not get although they are enabled installation-wide; `pinned` is stored and shown, not interpreted before D69; `applyAt` says when a change reaches a running agent.

blocked.description: Skill names this agent must not receive, even when enabled installation-wide.

pinned.description: Skill names pinned for this agent; currently stored and displayed but not interpreted.

applyAt.description: When a changed skill selection takes effect for a running agent.

extensions.description: Extension management (X1-R21): whether unsigned packages may be installed, how many days uninstalled items stay in the trash, and the size caps for packages and skill folders.

allowUnsigned.description: Whether unsigned extension packages may be installed.

trashDays.description: Number of days uninstalled extensions are retained in the trash.

limits.description: Maximum unpacked sizes for extension packages and skill folders.

packageBytes.description: Maximum size of an extension package, in bytes.

skillBytes.description: Maximum size of an installed skill folder, in bytes.

embedding.description: Embedding model use classification and non-commercial licence acknowledgement.

useClass.description: Intended use of the embedding model: general, research, or commercial.

acceptedNcLicence.description: Whether the owner has accepted the model's non-commercial licence terms.

acceptedNcLicenceAt.description: Date-time when the non-commercial licence was accepted.

engine.description: Pass-through to the engine's EngineConfig (57 keys, see docs/config-engine-keys.md). Every key here is class core until the engine declares readAt: live (engine PR E5).

refreshSkewSeconds.description: Refresh before expiration, plus up to 15 seconds of jitter.

voiceDailySeconds.description: Per-person and per-agent daily voice ceiling.

voiceCapacity.description: Maximum concurrent voice sessions, no greater than the provider tier.

clientRegistration.description: OpenAI-issued registration per person and workspace; no borrowed client IDs.

storeBackend.description: Use the existing secret service. auto permits only its explicitly enabled encrypted-file fallback.

federated.description: External bearer supplier: one executable or file, explicit arguments and environment.

decision.description: Reserved namespace for decision model configuration.

modelRoles.description: Model identifiers assigned to the supported functional roles.

additionalProperties.description: Model identifier assigned to the role.

modelProfiles.description: Named model profiles (C4): an ordered candidate list with weights for fallback or mixture-of-agents (moa) use, plus sampling parameters and cache hints. Data only; selection is the router's job. List order is priority order.

additionalProperties.description: Configuration for one named model profile.

strategy.description: How candidates are used: try in priority order (fallback) or combine them (moa).

candidates.description: Ordered model candidates; the first candidate has the highest priority.

items.description: A candidate model and its optional mixture weight.

weight.description: Relative contribution of this candidate when the moa strategy is used.

aggregator.description: Model identifier used to aggregate moa candidate outputs.

params.description: Sampling and output-size parameters for this profile.

topP.description: Nucleus-sampling probability threshold, greater than 0 and at most 1.

cache.description: Provider prompt-cache preference and optional time-to-live.

hint.description: Whether to use prompt caching automatically, never, or when preferred.

scan.description: Schedule for periodic local model discovery scans.

enabled.description: Whether periodic model discovery scans are enabled.

intervalHours.description: Hours between periodic model discovery scans.

secrets.description: Secret store (M2, ADR-005). The OS keyring is always tried first.

fileFallback.description: Settings for the encrypted-file secret-store fallback.

enabled.description: Use the encrypted file store (AES-256-GCM, machine-bound key file next to it) when the OS keyring is unavailable. Off until the owner decides ADR-005 Q3.

egress.description: Outgoing network policy (B4). Default deny: nothing is reachable until a host is listed. https only (plain http only to a listed loopback host when allowLoopback is on); private, link-local and metadata addresses are refused after name resolution whatever is listed.

allowHosts.description: Exact names, `*.suffix` (subdomains of any depth, not the apex), `*` (any name, never an IP literal) or an exact canonical IP literal (IPv6 in brackets).

allowPorts.description: Destination ports allowed for outgoing requests.

allowLoopback.description: Allow http(s) to loopback hosts (localhost, 127.0.0.0/8, ::1) that are also listed in allowHosts. A public name that resolves to loopback stays refused.

modules.description: Per-module settings, keyed by module name (B13). A change restarts only that module; `enabled: false` keeps it stopped.

additionalProperties.description: Settings for one installed module; unknown module-specific keys are retained.

enabled.description: Whether the module is allowed to run.
